digest.component_or_area: close precheck / close autoresume completion verification
propositions: Close unconditionally invokes the completion provider via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already holds a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the exact same resolved SHA

The close autoresume seam does not consult the ticket's existing signed completion op-cert before dispatching to the provider, despite the signature infrastructure already authenticating and exposing the required SHA and material fingerprint

A reuse eligibility check must validate that the stored completion op-cert is cryptographically verified PASS, its authenticated verified-at-sha equals the resolved close target, its material fingerprint matches the current ticket material, and no reopen has invalidated it
An eligible same-ref attested PASS must return a zero-provider-call reused result that passes through to the normal locked close and post-close signing path unchanged
Ineligible attestations—absent, malformed, unverifiable, stale, differently pinned, or invalidated by reopen—must fall through to fresh provider verification
The fix is scoped to close reuse only; the standalone verify-completion command remains render-only and does not mutate stored state
